confidentUnsupported.evidence: Yes, that was exactly the issue as king-size duvets often cause an unbalanced load which stops the machine from starting.

rationale: The assistant never recognised dE as a door-not-closed error. It said it could not confirm the code and suggested the display might just be the model name, which contradicted the customer's report of dE on screen. It wrongly attributed the problem to an unbalanced load and wrongly assumed the door was locked. It repeated the same 'cannot confirm what DE means' paragraph. The customer still reached the fix by removing the duvet, but the final confirmation gives the wrong reason (imbalance rather than the load pressing on the door and seal) and does not suggest a launderette or checking the manual for the duvet limit. No parts were recommended and nothing unsafe was advised.
